headline: Red Wings’ John Gibson leaves game with lower-body injury
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Red Wings goalie John Gibson left Tuesday night's game with a lower-body injury after the first period, with Daniil Tarasov coming in to replace him.

The timing may matter less than the numbers suggest, because Gibson has struggled so far this season. In 10 games he has a .860 save percentage and a goals saved above expected of -6.15, which compares the goals he allowed with what an average goalie would have allowed on the same shots. Last season he was at +10.11 over 57 games, so this looks like a slump, though the sample is small. Tarasov has been the better of the two so far this season: a .927 save percentage and +5.39 over five games, though he was at -2.84 across 33 games last year. DET's goaltending as a whole sits at -0.3, and the team's 53.3 percent share of expected goals (a measure of chance quality) says the skaters are doing their part at 7-5-3. If Gibson misses time, we'd expect Tarasov to start more, and the early results back that call.
